docs: Pinned advisory waivers for the buck2 dependency audit (toolchains/workspace-pnpm/run_audit.py). Each entry silences exactly one GHSA; any advisory not listed here still fails the audit at its configured level. An entry suppresses the GHSA for the ENTIRE workspace: every audit() target audits the shared root pnpm-lock.yaml, so per-app scoping is impossible — justify accordingly. Remove an entry as soon as its fix ships (the audit prints a note when a waiver matches nothing). Waivers are precedent-setting: every entry requires a non-empty reason and tracking ref (schema-enforced, build fails otherwise).

ignore.reason: next@14.x unauthenticated RCE on Windows-hosted servers only. Blink production is GKE/Linux on distroless images exclusively; no Windows-served environment exists. No 14.x patch (fix line starts at next 15.5.24).
ignore.ref: internal upgrade ticket (Next.js 15.5.24+, tracked in the team tracker)

ignore.reason: next@14.x AVIF/libheif decode RCE in the image optimizer. The vulnerable sharp->libheif path exists only in admin-panel, whose matcher-less next-auth middleware gates every path incl. /_next/image behind OAuth + email allowlist; the other apps use the bundled WASM decoder. No app sets images.remotePatterns/domains and no public endpoint echoes user-controlled bytes, so no attacker-supplied AVIF can reach a decoder. FRAGILE: adding sharp to another app, adding remotePatterns/domains, adding a middleware matcher to admin-panel/dashboard, or adding a byte-serving GET endpoint breaks this waiver — re-assess or upgrade first.
ignore.ref: internal upgrade ticket (Next.js 15.5.24+, tracked in the team tracker)

ignore.reason: next@14.x image optimizer RCE via an upstream image library used through sharp (SVG input). Every app sets images.unoptimized: true (#915), so /_next/image returns 404 before any decode (next-server handleNextImageRequest). Even with the optimizer on, no app sets images.remotePatterns/domains or dangerouslyAllowSVG, so no attacker-supplied image or SVG can reach a decoder, and sharp is only a dependency of admin-panel. No 14.x patch (fix line starts at next 15.5.28; sharp >= 0.35.5). FRAGILE: removing images.unoptimized from any app, adding remotePatterns/domains or dangerouslyAllowSVG breaks this waiver — re-assess or upgrade first.
ignore.ref: internal upgrade ticket (Next.js 15.5.28+, tracked in the team tracker)
